title: Springy Algerian Noodle Bowl
description: A flavorful and nutritious Algerian-inspired noodle bowl featuring hearty and springy noodles. This dish is perfect for a quick and easy meal.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil.
Cook the hearty noodles according to package instructions.
In a pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the Algerian spice mix and stir to combine.
Add the stick and springy vegetables to the pan and cook until tender.
Combine the cooked noodles and vegetable mixture.
